reply_text:
Found one merge-blocking issue in `receipt-lines` against `main` (`a6c40d4`):

*CRITICAL — Printed amounts are 100× too large* — `receipt/render.py:2`
`format_money()` formats integer cents directly as dollars. `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00` instead of `$12.99`; two coffees at 450 cents each print `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`.
*Fix:* Convert cents to dollars before formatting.

The existing test misses this: `tests/test_render.py:10` builds its expected output using the same broken formatter. Assert literal expected amounts (`$9.00`), and add a direct `format_money(1299) == '$12.99'` test.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
